Fasting after forty. Yes or no?
One. Do you have a history of disordered eating, or diabetes, or take medicine with food?
If yes, not without your doctor.
Two. Are you sleeping badly, or really stressed right now?
If yes, not right now. Eat three regular meals, with a twelve hour overnight gap.
Three. Can you still fit three meals of about thirty grams of protein into your window?
If yes, try it gently. If not, skip it.
